claim.claim-text: 1. A polystyrene composition comprising a hydrogen mediated anionic polymerization of styrene (HMAPS) polystyrene, the polystyrene having a polymer microstructure greater than 97 wt % head to tail microstructure as depicted by the following polymeric structure:

and having a polymer chain length distributions wherein less than 3.0% of the polymer chains have one or more quaternary carbons in the polymer microstructure and coproduct distribution(s) arising from a fragmentation polymerization processes, wherein the microstructure and purity of the chain length distribution is determined vide infra from gas chromatographic analyses of the lowest molecular weight chains obtained from the HMAPS distributions, where n=0 to n=2.

2. The polystyrene composition of claim 1, wherein the polymer microstructure is greater than 98 wt % head to tail, and polymer chain length distributions is less than 2.0 wt % of the polymer chains have one or more quaternary carbons in the polymer microstructure and coproduct distribution(s) arising from a fragmentation polymerization process.

3. The polystyrene composition of claim 1, wherein the polymer microstructure is greater than 99 wt % head to tail, and polymer chain length distributions is less than 1.0 wt % of the polymer chains have one or more quaternary carbons in the polymer microstructure and coproduct distribution(s) arising from a fragmentation polymerization process.

4. The polystyrene composition of claim 1, wherein the HMAPS polystyrene has a molecular weight distribution as measured by GPC (UV detector) analysis of the chain length distribution characterized by having M<n> in the range of from about 315 to about 934 Daltons; a M<w> in the range of from about 392 to about 1705 Daltons; and a M<z> is in the range of about 512 to about 2930 Daltons; a PD<n> is in the range of about 1.24 to about 1.82; with a standard deviation in the range of about 156 to about 849 Daltons and the asymmetry in the range of about 1.40 to about 3.00.

5. The polystyrene composition of claim 1, wherein the HMAPS polystyrene has a molecular weight distribution as measured by GPC (UV detector) analysis of the chain length distribution characterized by having M<n> is in the range of from about 400 to about 800 Daltons; M<w> in the range of from about 600 to about 1200 Daltons; a PD<n> in the range of about 1.35 to about 1.75; a standard deviation in the range of about 270 to about 550 Daltons and M<w> 10% High of less than about 3300 Daltons.

6. The polystyrene composition of claim 1, wherein the HMAPS polystyrene has a molecular weight distribution as measured by GPC (UV detector) analysis of the chain length distribution characterized by having M<n> in the range of from about 400 to about 800 Daltons; M<w> in the range of from about 600 to about 1200 Daltons; M<z> in the range of about 750 to about 1500 Daltons; PD<n> in the range of about 1.35 to about 1.75; standard deviation in the range of about 270 to about 550 Daltons; the asymmetry is in the range of about 1.60 to about 2.2; and M<w> 10% High of less than about 2400 Daltons.

7. A brominated polystyrene composition comprising a bromination product of a hydrogen mediated anionic polymerization of styrene (HMAPS) polystyrene, wherein the HMAPS polystyrene has a polymer microstructure that is greater than 97 wt % head to tail microstructure as depicted by the following polymeric structure:

and having a polymer chain length distributions wherein less than 3.0% of the polymer chains have one or more quaternary carbons in the polymer microstructure and coproduct distribution(s) arising from a fragmentation polymerization processes, wherein the microstructure and purity of the chain length distribution is determined vide infra from gas chromatographic analyses of the lowest molecular weight chains obtained from the HMAPS distributions, where n=0 to n=2.

8. The brominated polystyrene of claim 7, wherein the polymer microstructure is greater than 98 wt % head to tail, and polymer chain length distributions is less than 2.0 wt % of the polymer chains have one or more quaternary carbons in the polymer microstructure and coproduct distribution(s) arising from a fragmentation polymerization processes.

9. The brominated polystyrene composition of claim 7, wherein the HMAPS polystyrene has a molecular weight distribution as measured by GPC (UV detector) analysis of the chain length distribution characterized by having M<n> in the range of from about 315 to about 934 Daltons; a M<w> in the range of from about 392 to about 1705 Daltons; and a M<z> is in the range of about 512 to about 2930 Daltons; a PD<n> is in the range of about 1.24 to about 1.82; with a standard deviation in the range of about 156 to about 849 Daltons and the asymmetry is in the range of about 1.40 to about 3.00.

12. The brominated polystyrene composition of claim 7, wherein the brominated polystyrene has one or more of (i) a bromine content in the range of about 73 wt % to about 77 wt % based on the total weight of brominated polystyrene; (ii), a thermal HBr value at 300° C. below the detection limit of 50 ppm and no more than about 1000 ppm based upon the total weight of the brominated polystyrene; (iii) a thermogravimetric (TGA) weight loss of 5% occurring at a temperature greater than about 355° C. to about 375° C.; and (iv) a glass transition temperature in the range of about 110° C. to about 155° C.
